verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at auth0.com (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of docs pages that point agents to the llms.txt documentation index. Many product pages are also served as .md, and llms-full.txt files exist for the changelog and case studies, giving agents several machine-readable entry points. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually work well with these files, and visibility into how completely llms.txt covers the full docs (the probe content is truncated).
